title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Discharge and Closure of the Acceptance File
content:
## Clause

For Dangerous Goods Acceptance, the discharge of the goods and the closure of the acceptance file are entered by the vessel and terminal systems; the desk never records either of them. From the moment the goods are discharged, the file can no longer be amended, withdrawn or re-reviewed.

## What a discharged or closed file can still receive

| Kind of entry | Possible once discharged? |
|---|---|
| Payment | yes |
| Goodwill waiver of a fee already booked | yes |
| Misdeclaration finding | yes |
| Amendment of the declaration | no |
| Withdrawal | no |
| Re-review | no |

## Points of judgement

**A shipper asks to change the declared weight after discharge.** An amendment is no longer possible on that file.

**Can a goodwill waiver still be given after discharge?** Yes, for a fee that had already been booked.
